name: Bike Workshop (PHP + MySQL)
postCreateCommand: sudo bash -c 'PHP_INI_DIR=/usr/local/etc/php docker-php-ext-install pdo_mysql' && composer install && npm install && npm run build && ( [ -f .env ] || cp .env.example .env ) && php artisan key:generate --ansi && for i in $(seq 1 30); do (echo > /dev/tcp/mysql/3306) >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 2; done && php artisan migrate --graceful --seed --ansi
